en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Sa’ad, from Muhammad Bin Fuzayl, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Everything by which the man opens his sustenance with, so it is his business’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Sa‘d ibn Sa‘d from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
With whatever (lawful) means one opens the door to his sustenance it is business and trade.’”
